title: Mirabel and the Visitor
author: Gideon Blackwood
blurb: Orsen Blackwood, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
